ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
ourKits.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
ourKits.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
ourKits.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
ourKits.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health

ourKits.combo: Mortal Coil to pull enemies together and heal from them, Stupor from the air to Mesmerize, Soulfire waves for damage, then Abyssal Rift to teleport in and fire the singularity.
ourKits.winCondition: Collect Essence to grow every ability, then zone fights with Mortal Coil and Abyssal Rift and execute low targets.
ourKits.passive: Echoes of the Damned: nearby deaths can drop Essence (heroes always do) that she collects to empower her abilities, and she can hover after a mid-air jump.
ourKits.playWith: A frontline that keeps enemies inside Mortal Coil and the singularity.
ourKits.playAgainst: Watch for the 1.5s Abyssal Rift channel and leave the target area, and dodge the Stupor orb after she rises. Anti-heal cuts Mortal Coil healing; trade early before she stacks Essence.

ourKits.combo: Shadow Slip dashes in, Eventide and Blade Siphon hit to apply Haemorrhage, then Feast suppresses the Haemorrhaged target for bonus damage and full healing, with Shadow Slip recast to swap back out
ourKits.winCondition: Feast a Haemorrhaged squishy for bonus damage, heal it back, and escape through the Shadow swap
ourKits.passive: hitting a hero with two abilities within a short window applies Haemorrhage, a max-health true-damage bleed
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: Feast is her engage, so peel or punish after it is spent; note where her Shadow was left, since she can swap back to it; magic armor and anti-heal blunt her Blade Siphon and Feast healing

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
ourKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
ourKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
ourKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
ourKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch dashes in to stun, Left Crunch and Right Crunch build Turbo, then the Turbo Crunch version (long push dash, true-damage double swipe, or knockup uppercut) lands, with Re-Crunch repeating the last ability
ourKits.winCondition: chain abilities into Turbo Crunch empowered hits and heal through Re-Crunch's passive
ourKits.passive: each ability empowers his next basic attack and cuts his cooldowns; two ability casts activate Turbo Crunch, enhancing his next basic ability
ourKits.playWith: engage and peel-stripping teammates so he can reach the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: fight after Forward Crunch is used, since it is his long-cooldown gap closer; respect his second ability cast because the next one is Turbo-enhanced; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch healing and armor helps against his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Saturation Charge mines to slow, Frag Order to launch enemies, Orbital Sanction to track them, Rally Point to knock back divers and heal allies.
enemyKits.winCondition: Hold an area with Orbital Sanction and mines while Rally Point keeps his team healthy and his rifle on infinite ammo.
enemyKits.passive: Ballistic Calibration turns bonus attack speed into ability haste and unlocks ability upgrades at item stat thresholds.
enemyKits.playWith: Frontliners who fight inside Rally Point's heal and hold enemies in the Orbital beam.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.

enemyKits.combo: Mercy for 3 Vengeance stacks, Dusk to purify for burst and slow, Shadow Glide to reposition, then Purge while gliding as needed.
enemyKits.winCondition: Stack Vengeance with basics and abilities, then shred the team with Purge and reset Dusk and Shadow Glide on kills.
enemyKits.passive: Nevermore periodically makes her next basic or Mercy fire a Raven that deals current-health damage in a small area.
enemyKits.playWith: Peel that keeps divers off her while she channels Purge.
enemyKits.playAgainst: During Purge she cannot attack or cast anything but Shadow Glide and is slowed, so CC her then. Avoid feeding takedowns since they reset Shadow Glide, and expect Purge's anti-heal.

enemyKits.combo: Web Lash roots a hero or leaps from terrain to knock up and stun, Crushing Maw bites for damage and healing, Hellfire's Demon Eye stacks slows, then Consume pulls enemies into his maw to bite and execute
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Hunger to become Awakened, then win extended fights with Awakened damage reduction, armor shred and Consume executes
enemyKits.passive: dealing and taking damage builds Hunger for more healing; at max Hunger he is Awakened with damage reduction and empowered basic abilities
enemyKits.playWith: teammates with follow-up damage on his Web Lash root who can push targets into Consume execute range
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Web Lash and watch for him lashing to walls before the leap stun; stay out of the Consume cone while he is slowed pulling, and avoid long trades once he is Awakened; buy anti-heal for his Crushing Maw and Consume healing

enemyKits.combo: Lash Kick in for the slow → Windburn for range and cleave → third-hit max-health damage and heal → Backlash to push away, Quelling Gale to stop projectiles
enemyKits.winCondition: stick with Lash Kick, ramp Rising Storm attack speed and out-trade with Windburn's healing third hits
enemyKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks from basics and Lash Kick grant attack speed
enemyKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick off isolated targets
enemyKits.playAgainst: Backlash reflects projectiles and Quelling Gale halts them, so use melee or ground effects while they are up; fight after Lash Kick is used, and buy anti-heal against Windburn

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
enemyKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
enemyKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
enemyKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

3 divers (Countess, Crunch, Greystone): each one past the first is a hero not holding the line.
Greystone at support is a diver: nobody stays with the carry.
Draft fix: Countess (offlane) for a real tank: Kaelen 54.9%, Riktor 51.1%, Steel 50.7%.
Legion 13/3/7, 50% of their kills, 39957 hero damage (the most in the game).
Killed Renna 5, Sparrow 3, Crunch 2, Greystone 2, Countess 1.
Hard CC: Frag Order (knock-up), Rally Point (knockback).
Mobility: Frag Order.
Unstoppable on Rally Point: CC does not stop it.
Self-healing in the kit (Rally Point).

Play against: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.
Answers: Physical armor on whoever it kept killing. Anti-heal: Tainted Rounds, or Tainted Scepter. Tenacity on the players it caught.

Item answer: Anti-heal: Tainted Scepter.

They brought 8 hard-CC abilities to our 5. Fight after Steel's Shield Slam and Akeron's Web Lash and Steel's Shield Bash are used, spread out instead of grouping in a line, and the front line can buy tenacity.

bullets: Malady's bonus hit landed on a hero below 40% health, then went on cooldown; takedowns reset the cooldown, so Legion's 13 kills brought repeated bonus hits.
Casting Orbital Sanction triggered Spear Of Desolation's 10% damage boost for 6s, and 33 ability haste cut the ultimate to about 82.7s by the end.
Aion: each cast added mana regeneration, ability damage on heroes added gold. Bottomless Vial refilled potions on river buffs. Runic Focus boosts magical power, which the build lacked.
Every basic attack carried Sky Splitter damage, Scattershot added homing shots on a short cooldown, and every third straight hit triggered Windburn's bonus damage and heal for Yin.
On a melee hero, Onixian Quiver adds 25% critical strike chance and damage reduction that grows as Yin loses health; Imperator makes those critical strikes hit 30% harder.
Weald fired true damage missiles on damaging a hero below the health threshold, once per hero per cooldown; Taproot healed Yin per basic attack; Forage added farm gold.
Forticus shielded Greystone on taking hero damage, on a cooldown, and Transference turned part of leftover shield into health; Stoicism's armor and regeneration grew as Greystone lost health.
Idrisil added armor while Greystone stayed above the health threshold, then traded that bonus for a shield on dropping below the threshold, then went on cooldown.
Enemy basic attacks on Greystone triggered Cold Hearted's slow plus Tainted Guard's healing cut and bleed on the attacker; Icy Touch let Greystone's hits lower enemy attack speed.
